safety.remoteAccess: SELECT-only catalog evidence captured during Task 6; no new production query was run for this matrix.

canonicalization.comparisonRule: Compare presence first, then compare only comparison.assertedFields using exact JSON scalar/array/object equality.
canonicalization.objectOrder: objects sorted by id using ordinal Unicode string order; coverage rows sorted by remote version or baseline filename; objectIds sorted by object id.

arrays.apiExecuteGrantees: PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role; absent roles omitted
arrays.apiPrivileges: object keys PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role; privileges ordered DELETE, INSERT, MAINTAIN, REFERENCES, SELECT, TRIGGER, TRUNCATE, UPDATE
arrays.policyRoles: PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, then lexicographic fallback

hashes.bodySha256: SHA-256 of the local dollar-quoted body or pg_proc.prosrc after CRLF/CR to LF, trailing horizontal whitespace removal, and outer whitespace trim.
hashes.expressionSha256: SHA-256 after LF normalization, lowercase folding, public. removal, ::text removal, grouping-parenthesis removal while retaining empty function-call parentheses, whitespace collapse, comma normalization, and equals-spacing removal.
hashes.defaultSha256: SHA-256 after LF normalization, trailing horizontal whitespace removal, outer trim, and whitespace collapse; null means no default.
hashes.commentSha256: SHA-256 after LF normalization, trailing horizontal whitespace removal, and outer trim; null means no comment.
hashes.definitionSha256: Uses expressionSha256 canonicalization on the safe catalog definition.

canonicalization.grants: Effective ACLs are exploded. Function comparison includes only EXECUTE for API roles. Relation comparison uses the exact per-role privilege object; owner privileges are excluded. For REVOKE-only baselines, unmentioned privileges are preserved from the observed capture and the explicit local deltas are applied to form expected.
